name: relational-transport
cmd: set -euo pipefail; root=$PWD; out=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; export PATH="$root/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; export LEAN_PATH="$root/research/bapa:$root/lean-kernel"; lean -o research/bapa/RelationalFragment.olean research/bapa/RelationalFragment.lean > "$out/RelationalFragment.log" 2>&1; lean research/bapa/RelationalNumeric.lean > "$out/RelationalNumeric.log" 2>&1; lean research/bapa/RelationalSmallModel.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/RelationalSmallModel.log"; lean research/bapa/RelationalControls.lean 2>&1 | tee "$out/RelationalControls.log"; cp research/bapa/RelationalFragment.lean research/bapa/RelationalNumeric.lean research/bapa/RelationalSmallModel.lean research/bapa/RelationalControls.lean "$out/"; for msg in research/bapa/transport-commit.txt research/bapa/tcommit-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/numeric-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/cutoff-transport-commit.txt research/bapa/control-transport-commit.txt; do bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$msg"; done > "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1
